name: agent-tool-desktop-product-boundary
purpose: Defines the second desktop app product boundary for agent, tool, Ollama, provider, and AgentCore-style operations.

reader_guide.summary: Use this registry before adding agent factory, tool studio, Ollama, provider direct execution, or cloud agent runtime features to either desktop app.
how_to_read: Read product_identity to confirm this is a separate installable desktop app, not a hidden tab in the workspace tracker.
Read relationship_to_other_projects before moving code or UI between platform-desktop-app, agent-tool-desktop-app, and agent-platform.
Read feature_ownership to decide whether a capability belongs here or in the workspace tracker.
Read release_boundaries before claiming the app is runnable or distributable.
update_triggers: A feature touches agent creation, tool management, Ollama, provider execution, or cloud agent lifecycle.
A UI surface moves between project management and agent/tool operations.
A desktop runtime, installer, updater, or package command is introduced.

structure_rules.rule: Agent/tool/Ollama operations shall be delivered as a separate installable desktop app product, not only as a Python project, hidden settings page, or optional tab in the workspace tracker.
structure_rules.reason: The user clarified that both split products are desktop apps.

structure_rules.rule: agent-platform shall provide reusable agent specs, policies, validators, and runtime contracts for this product, but it is not the user-facing desktop product home.
structure_rules.reason: Keeping engine and product homes separate prevents the second app from becoming an internal config folder.

structure_rules.rule: Git workspace portfolio, task timeline, evidence, reports, and terminal state remain owned by platform-desktop-app.
structure_rules.reason: The first desktop app must stay simple for project management and AI coding workspace tracking.

structure_rules.rule: Provider credentials, local model management, installs, cloud runtime setup, and destructive tool operations require explicit privacy, rollback, and validation gates before runtime implementation.
structure_rules.reason: The second desktop app will manage higher-risk operations than the workspace tracker.
